text:
sam: Deploy-bot flagged helm release `infra/inference-api` chart bump 2.14.0 -> 2.15.0. Preflight failed: values.schema validation - `db.pool.max` (200) > allowed max (100). Holding canary.

deploy-bot: Canary started (3 pods) at 2026-03-18T16:41:08Z. preflight: values.schema_error - path `db.pool.max` value=200 exceeds schema.max=100.

kevin: Thanks. Was that default increase intentional? Changelog shows default pool went up from 50 -> 200.

maya: Not from app team. Looks like a transitive bump in the postgres subchart. Pulling chart and values.yaml now.

lisa: Heads up — we're in a change window but we can't sit on a blocked canary forever. ops will enforce the 30m SLA.

kevin: If default pool jumps x4 we risk OOMs on small nodes. Proposal: pin Chart version to 2.14.1 for this release and run canary with an override `db.pool.max=50` until we sort defaults.

sam: Agreed. We can also do an override on the release: `helm upgrade --install inference-api redwood/inference-api --version 2.15.0 --reuse-values --set db.pool.max=50 --namespace prod --wait --timeout 5m` — that should keep runtime stable while we patch charts.

maya: I created a quick branch chartfix/pin-2.14.1 and a PR to adjust the default to 75. But we should hotfix the CI/release path first.

kevin: @ops can you pin the ChartRef in the release pipeline to 2.14.1 for this run?

ops: ops: We can pin the chart in the pipeline and re-trigger the canary. Preparing a hotfix job now. ETA ~12m. Will apply pipeline override and comment with job id.

deploy-bot: Action required: manual approval to proceed with pinned chart 2.14.1 and override `db.pool.max=50`. Approve by reacting :white_check_mark: or run `approve deploy 1838502468` in this thread.

sam: :white_check_mark: approved.

deploy-bot: Canary resumed with pinned chart 2.14.1 and override `db.pool.max=50`. Monitoring CPU/memory and readiness for 20m.

lisa: Add a follow-up: CI gate to catch schema-breaking default changes. This slipped through because chart authors changed defaults without a schema bump.

kevin: Plan: if canary is healthy after 20m we roll forward. If not, immediate rollback to previous release image tag `sha-abcdef` and unpin chart.

maya: Noted. I'll merge the PR to fix defaults and add an entry in release notes explaining the temporary pin and why.

kevin: Thanks everyone. Leaving a brief postmortem card and tagging infra owners for long-term fix.

lisa: Reminder for release notes: call out `db.pool.max` change, why we pinned to 2.14.1, and the hotfix commands used.

sam: Closing the loop: canary healthy at +22m, rolling to remainder of cluster. Will follow up with changelog/pm notes.
